description: Connecticut’s top-down approach to affordable housing is both bad law and bad policy. By overriding local zoning authority, the Democratic supermajority in Hartford—including Senator James Maroney—has created a system that punishes municipalities, disregards established zoning principles, restricts public participation, and favors private developers over residents.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Weaver2026, Angela Driver Treasurer
title: Affordable Housing Shouldn’t Mean Surrendering Local Control
